summary: This study tested the drug luseogliflozin in people with type 2 diabetes who take moderate-dose insulin. Researchers wanted to see how the medication affects insulin resistance and the risk of a condition called ketoacidosis, which means having high levels of acids called ketones in the blood. The trial included 40 participants and compared those taking the drug to a control group with no changes to their medication. This Phase 3 trial was sponsored by Aimi Fadilah Mohamad and has been completed.
